about: Models used by the Kitty Open Studio workflows. Weights are never bundled: the installer downloads them from `url` into ComfyUI/models/<folder>/<filename>. `workflows`, `group` and `min_vram_gb` are derived by backend/tools/manifest.py sync.

gpu_profiles.48gb: default files (INT8 ConvRot / FP8 / BF16 as listed)
